content: You only get one chance at a first impression, and getting to introduce Apple’s first folding phone is certainly a strong way to start things off as Apple’s CEO. On The Vergecast today, we’re talking all about Apple’s launch event: how John Ternus did in his first appearance as CEO, what we make of the new iPhones, and whether Apple is stepping into dangerous territory with its new AI features on the Apple Watch. First up, Allison Johnson joins me to discuss the new iPhones, which she had a chance to test in Cupertino. Both of us have some questions about the new variable aperture camera on the iPhone 18 Pro — and whether the real upgrade simply lies in the wider aperture, not the ability to stop it down. Then we dig into the iPhone Duo and how Apple decided to pick and choose the best parts of Android foldables. Watch | Listen | Get ad-free After that, Victoria Song joins me to discuss the new Apple Watches, which she also had a chance to test out. We dive into the new sensor array and whether it allows for legitimately new metrics or just more vibesy health data. And then we both break down a little while figuring out what it means that Apple added the ability for both new Apple Watches to have an always-on microphone that summarizes all of your conversations. This is an Apple-packed episode, so from there we jump to a special segment with Nilay Patel and David Imel, who speak with AI researcher CJ Trowbridge about the state of running local LLMs on the Mac. Finally, it’s the long awaited return of the Thunder Round, as we race through stories so that Allison can make it to the airport. We’re chatting OpenAI math drama, digital ocarinas, and more. If you want to learn more about this week’s stories, you can check out the links below: * iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max: Our first hands-on impressions * The variable aperture isn’t the cool part of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera * Hands-on with the foldable iPhone Duo * Hands-on with the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 * Apple Watch Series 12 has an always-on Siri that makes AI recaps of your day * Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy * Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work * OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia * Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone * The Trump phone just got a $250 price hike * Six years later, Sony revisits its legendary XM4 headphones * Hori’s electronic Ocarina of Time requires no musical talent.

chineseContent: 你只有一次机会获得第一印象，而推出苹果首款折叠手机无疑是作为苹果首席执行官开始工作的一个强有力的方式。今天，我们在 The Vergecast 上谈论苹果的发布会：约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 首次担任首席执行官时表现如何，我们对新款 iPhone 的看法，以及苹果在 Apple Watch 上推出的新人工智能功能是否正在步入危险领域。首先，艾莉森·约翰逊 (Allison Johnson) 和我一起讨论新款 iPhone，她有机会在库比蒂诺测试了这款 iPhone。我们俩都对 iPhone 18 Pro 上的新型可变光圈摄像头有一些疑问，以及真正的升级是否仅仅在于更大的光圈，而不是缩小光圈的能力。然后我们深入研究 iPhone Duo 以及苹果如何决定挑选 Android 可折叠手机的最佳部分。观看 |听|没有广告之后，宋茜和我一起讨论了新款 Apple Watch，她也有机会试用了这款手表。我们深入研究新的传感器阵列，以及它是否允许合法的新指标或只是更振动的健康数据。然后我们俩都陷入了思考，想知道苹果为两款新 Apple Watch 增加了一个始终开启的麦克风来总结所有对话的功能，这意味着什么。这是一个充满苹果内容的剧集，因此我们从那里跳到 Nilay Patel 和 David Imel 的特别部分，他们与 AI 研究员 CJ Trowbridge 讨论了在 Mac 上运行本地法学硕士的状况。最后，是期待已久的雷霆回合回归，我们快速讲述故事，以便艾莉森能够到达机场。我们正在谈论 OpenAI 数学戏剧、数字陶笛等等。如果您想了解更多本周的故事，可以查看以下链接： * iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max：
